program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((mask-cells (filter-cells g (lambda (r c v) (= v 5))))
         (norm (normalize-cells mask-cells)))
    (if (empty? mask-cells)
        (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
        (for*/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
                   ([r (in-range (rows g))]
                    [c (in-range (cols g))]
                    #:when (let ((v (at g r c))) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 5)))))
          (paint-cells out
            (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows g) (cols g)))
                    (map (lambda (d) (list (+ r (first d)) (+ c (second d)))) norm))
            (at g r c))))))
